description: Primary operator view for signal throughput, delivered-signal outcomes, paper trading, and shadow experiments.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Generated" FROM signal_predictions WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.description: Signals created by the generation pipeline during the last 24 hours.
panels.title: Generated Signals · 24h

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Delivered" FROM signal_predictions WHERE pipeline_stage = 'delivered' AND created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.description: Signals delivered to the configured Telegram destination during the last 24 hours.
panels.title: Delivered Signals · 24h

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Suppressed" FROM signal_predictions WHERE pipeline_stage = 'suppressed_delivery' AND created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.description: Repeat deliveries blocked by delivery deduplication during the last 24 hours.
panels.title: Duplicate Deliveries Blocked · 24h

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE pipeline_stage = 'delivered')::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS "Delivery Rate" FROM signal_predictions WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.description: Share of generated signals that reached the delivered pipeline stage in the last 24 hours.
panels.title: Delivery Rate · 24h

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN outcome_label = 'win' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Win Rate (7d)" FROM signal_predictions WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND pipeline_stage = 'delivered' AND created_at >= now() - interval '7 days';
SELECT avg(return_pct) AS "Avg Return (7d)" FROM signal_predictions WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND pipeline_stage = 'delivered' AND created_at >= now() - interval '7 days';
SELECT avg(return_pct) AS "Avg Return (all time)" FROM signal_predictions WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND pipeline_stage = 'delivered';

panels.description: Average resolved return across all delivered signals. This is historical signal performance, not paper-portfolio PnL.
panels.title: Avg Return · All Time

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN outcome_label = 'win' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Win Rate (24h)" FROM signal_predictions WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND pipeline_stage = 'delivered' AND created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours';

SELECT source_channel, count(*) AS signals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AS resolved, round(avg(CASE WHEN outcome_label = 'win' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 3) AS win_rate, round(avg(return_pct) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 5) AS avg_return FROM signal_predictions WHERE pipeline_stage = 'delivered' AND source_channel IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source_channel HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_return DESC;

panels.description: Delivered-signal results by primary Telegram channel. Channels appear only after at least five resolved signals.
panels.title: Telegram Source Performance · Min 5 Resolved

targets.rawSql: SELECT ticker, count(*) AS signals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AS resolved, round(avg(CASE WHEN outcome_label = 'win' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 3) AS win_rate, round(avg(return_pct) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 5) AS avg_return FROM signal_predictions WHERE pipeline_stage = 'delivered' GROUP BY ticker HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_return DESC;

panels.description: Delivered-signal results by ticker. Tickers appear only after at least five resolved signals.
panels.title: Ticker Performance · Min 5 Resolved

panels.description: Initial virtual cash plus realized net PnL for the most recently started paper portfolio.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_portfolio AS (SELECT name, initial_cash FROM paper_portfolios ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT (portfolio.initial_cash + COALESCE(sum(position.net_pnl) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed'), 0))::double precision AS "Realized Equity" FROM latest_portfolio portfolio LEFT JOIN paper_portfolio_positions position ON position.portfolio_name = portfolio.name GROUP BY portfolio.initial_cash;

panels.title: Paper Realized Equity

panels.description: Net result after modeled commission and slippage for closed virtual positions.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_portfolio AS (SELECT name FROM paper_portfolios ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT COALESCE(sum(position.net_pnl), 0)::double precision AS "Realized PnL" FROM latest_portfolio portfolio LEFT JOIN paper_portfolio_positions position ON position.portfolio_name = portfolio.name AND position.status = 'closed';

panels.title: Paper Realized PnL

panels.description: Current count of open virtual positions in the latest paper portfolio.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_portfolio AS (SELECT name FROM paper_portfolios ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT count(position.id) AS "Open Positions" FROM latest_portfolio portfolio LEFT JOIN paper_portfolio_positions position ON position.portfolio_name = portfolio.name AND position.status = 'open';

panels.title: Paper Open Positions

panels.description: Resolved virtual positions available for performance evaluation.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_portfolio AS (SELECT name FROM paper_portfolios ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT count(position.id) AS "Closed Positions" FROM latest_portfolio portfolio LEFT JOIN paper_portfolio_positions position ON position.portfolio_name = portfolio.name AND position.status = 'closed';

panels.title: Paper Closed Positions

targets.rawSql: SELECT ai_gate_decision, count(*) AS signals, round(avg(CASE WHEN outcome_label = 'win' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)::numeric, 3) AS win_rate, round(avg(return_pct)::numeric, 5) AS ev FROM signal_predictions WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND ai_gate_decision IS NOT NULL AND pipeline_stage = 'delivered' GROUP BY ai_gate_decision ORDER BY ai_gate_decision;

SELECT CASE WHEN source_weight IS NULL THEN 'no_weight' WHEN source_weight >= 1.1 THEN 'strong (>=1.1)' WHEN source_weight >= 1.0 THEN 'neutral (1.0-1.09)' ELSE 'weak (<1.0)' END AS weight_tier, count(*) AS signals, round(avg(CASE WHEN outcome_label = 'win' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)::numeric, 3) AS win_rate, round(avg(return_pct)::numeric, 5) AS ev FROM signal_predictions WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND pipeline_stage = 'delivered' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT COALESCE(global_alignment, 'not_enriched') AS alignment, count(*) AS signals, round(avg(CASE WHEN outcome_label = 'win' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)::numeric, 3) AS win_rate, round(avg(return_pct)::numeric, 5) AS ev FROM signal_predictions WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND pipeline_stage = 'delivered' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
